# SiTime to Present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on September 9, 2026


September 02, 2026


SANTA CLARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 2, 2026--[SiTime Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sitime.com%2F&esheet=54598117&newsitemid=20260902953485&lan=en-US&anchor=SiTime+Corporation&index=1&md5=7e87798e957d12330eac6f04fa285bba) (Nasdaq: SITM), the Precision Timing company, today announced that the Company will participate at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference to be held at the Palace Hotel, San Francisco. SiTime management is scheduled to host a fireside chat at 3:45 p.m. Pacific Time on Wednesday, September 9, 2026.


A live and archived webcast of the Company’s fireside chat will be available in the[Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.sitime.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fevents&esheet=54598117&newsitemid=20260902953485&lan=en-US&anchor=Events&index=2&md5=9ad9b0ca5925b3fcdecab38b843ead65) section of SiTime’s Investor Relations website.


**About SiTime**


SiTime Corporation is the Precision Timing company. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit[www.sitime.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sitime.com%2F&esheet=54598117&newsitemid=20260902953485&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sitime.com&index=3&md5=35f7ee44c97be97e719cbe33a3388204) .


**About Precision Timing**


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronic systems, ensuring reliable operation over their lifetime. For decades, quartz-based devices, built on non-semiconductor technology, have delivered this critical function, but they struggle in harsh, demanding environments. SiTime’s Precision Timing, based on semiconductor MEMS technology, delivers superior performance, greater resilience, smaller size and higher reliability. Today, it powers more than 400 applications, including those in high-growth segments such as AI data centers, industrial and humanoid robots, mobile, wearables, IoT and automated driving.
